public_rationale: GPT-5 exposes interfaces for constrained tool outputs, but output formatting does not establish reliable models of the subjects discussed. The retrieved documentation also cannot establish that programmers lack every usable representation. No direct validation matching the claim was found. Calling the claim supported solely because there is no separately named world-model interface would add a requirement Marcus did not state. No decisive event closes this undated forecast.
limitations: The meaning of an accessible subject model materially affects what evidence would count.
Documentation of interfaces is not a semantic reliability test.
The search does not establish a universal absence of usable representations.
